supersedes.reason: Independent slice review found that the newly introduced Core performance gate compared rounded statistics, did not invalidate stale PASS evidence before measurement, and did not hold commit-bound inputs through final PASS publication. This record binds the raw-precision, tombstone-first, locked-input remediation and its independently reproducible tests.

outcome: Canonical project state uses the approved strict SQLite profile, backup-first migrations, sealed repository boundaries, and a Core package whose performance PASS can be published only from exact raw measurements under continuously held commit/package authority.

The exact 661-file / 38,301,316-byte package, report, embedded manifest, evidence, contract, schema, baseline/hash and tool remained locked and revalidated immediately before atomic PASS replacement. Report SHA-256: 139078d6dd0073d8e5d9a960e125e23c3315cf53b5a5bf176021e6e6ea0a65ab.

The focused remediation is formatted, lint-clean, and type-clean. The full governed quality check also passed all 94 Python files; report SHA-256: 524a8d6779db53c631e8671e340a166a58bcfeca049d2f567d012ae8e64d3af7.

The exact remediation state emits clean build identity 0.1.0+g33ef759 with no dirty paths; build-manifest SHA-256: fe34810e28a84b2c0c0130cdd949dbbf3bbca976f7fc32457e24533d991e6cca. Backlog, Wave campaign, generated views, and patch hygiene pass.

retainedEvidence.focusedIntegrationUnion: 55/55 PASS before review. The remediation changes only the performance qualification tool, its direct tests, and reviewed baseline bytes; SQLite runtime, schema, migrations, repositories, frozen package bytes, security policy, product UI, and UI-reference bytes are unchanged.

failureBoundary: Qualification compares retained raw nearest-rank statistics to unrounded absolute and relative limits; rounding is presentation-only.
A qualifying run replaces any previous result with a NONQUALIFYING IN_PROGRESS tombstone before reading the baseline or measuring the package.

Tracked tool, baseline/hash, package evidence, build contract and artifact schema must equal the exact state-commit blobs; package report/manifest/inventory and every artifact file remain held through measurement and final publication.

The final publisher verifies directory, temporary bytes/identity and every captured input immediately before a handle-relative atomic replace. That replace is the last rejecting operation; cleanup cannot turn a returned PASS into a failed run.
Interruption or persistent final/fallback publication failure leaves the already-published tombstone, never a stale or current PASS.
